description: 国王印度 E91 — 马占据弱格据点

intro.popup_en: Knights and Weak Squares, Lesson 3: After White's d5 wedge, a knight occupies d5 as an outpost. Black counters with ...g5, creating tactical complications and exchanges, but the knight on d5 remains firmly established.
intro.popup:
马占据弱格据点 第3课

d5楔子后白马强占Nd5
黑方g5反击造成战术风暴

Nxe4/Nxg3等交换后
Nd5据点始终屹立！

outro.popup_en: White's d5 wedge creates the weak square for Nxd5. Black's ...g5 and ...Nxe4 tactics do not dislodge the knight; after Nd2 and hxg3, the outpost remains. A true weak-square outpost can survive a tactical storm.
outro.popup:
马据点战术小结
✅ d5楔子后Nxd5建立据点
✅ 黑g5+Nxe4战术未能动摇Nd5
✅ Nd2反击，hxg3后据点屹立

核心原则：
真正的弱格据点，战术风暴中也稳固！

moves.popup_en: d4 controls the center.
moves.popup: d4控制中心

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 develops a knight and begins the King's Indian Defense.
moves.popup:
Nf6发展马
国王印度防御开始

moves.popup_en: c4 expands White's center.
moves.popup: c4扩张

moves.popup_en: ...g6 prepares the King's Indian fianchetto.
moves.popup:
g6飞象布局
国王印度特征

moves.popup_en: Nc3 develops a knight.
moves.popup: Nc3发展马

moves.popup_en: ...Bg7! Black's King's Indian bishop watches the center along the long diagonal from h8 to a1.
moves.popup:
Bg7国王印度象
沿h8-a1对角线虎视眈眈

moves.popup_en: e4 occupies the center and gives White a space advantage.
moves.popup:
e4占领中心
白方中心优势

moves.popup_en: ...d6 prevents White from establishing an e5 wedge.
moves.popup:
d6防守
防止e5楔子

moves.popup_en: Nf3 develops a knight.
moves.popup: Nf3发展马

moves.popup_en: ...O-O castles.
moves.popup: O-O入城

moves.popup_en: Be2 is a solid developing move.
moves.popup: Be2稳健发展

moves.popup_en: ...c5! Black challenges the center and seeks counterplay.
moves.popup:
c5挑战中心！
黑方寻求反击

moves.popup_en: d5! The wedge is a key move. It blocks Black's c- and d-files and leaves e6 and f5 as potential weak squares.
moves.popup:
d5楔子！关键一步
封锁黑方c+d列交流
此后e6和f5成为弱格

moves.popup_en: ...e6 counterattacks and tries to open the wedge.
moves.popup:
e6反击！
黑方试图打开楔子

moves.popup_en: Bg5 applies pressure and eyes the kingside near h7.
moves.popup:
Bg5施压
攻击h7方向

moves.popup_en: ...h6 challenges the bishop.
moves.popup: h6赶象

moves.popup_en: Bh4 preserves the bishop and maintains pressure.
moves.popup:
Bh4保留
继续施压

moves.popup_en: exd5 opens the center. White accepts an isolated pawn, but the contest for d5 begins.
moves.popup:
exd5打开中路
接受孤立兵，但...
d5格的争夺开始！

moves.popup_en: Nxd5! White's knight occupies the weak square as a strong outpost. Can any black pawn drive it away?
moves.popup:
Nxd5！白马飞入d5
强占弱格据点
看这匹马：有任何黑兵能赶走它吗？

moves.popup_en: ...g5! Black counterattacks aggressively, challenging Bh4 and hoping to recover the e4-pawn amid the complications.
moves.popup:
g5！黑方激进反击
进攻Bh4，试图逼退白象
并趁乱夺回e4兵！

moves.popup_en: Bg3! The bishop retreats without meeting ...g4 directly, but the e4-pawn loses an important defender.
moves.popup:
Bg3！象撤退g3
不与g4对碰
但此时e4兵失去强力守护

moves.popup_en: ...Nxe4! Black wins a pawn tactically. The knight from f6 jumps in and attacks White's knight; this was the point of ...g5.
moves.popup:
Nxe4！战术得兵！
Nf6跳入e4，白马被打
这就是g5的目的！

moves.popup_en: Nd2! White counterattacks the knight on e4 and refuses to let Black win material without a fight.
moves.popup:
Nd2！反击！
Nf3跳到d2攻击e4马
白方不让黑方白赚

moves.popup_en: ...Nxg3! Black is forced to exchange, taking the bishop on g3 with the knight from e4. White accepts doubled pawns as a manageable cost.
moves.popup:
Nxg3被迫兑换！
e4马打g3象，取象撤退
白方叠兵但局面可以接受

moves.popup_en: hxg3 rebuilds the pawn structure. White has doubled h-pawns, but the key point is that the knight on d5 remains untouched.
moves.popup:
hxg3重建
白方h列叠兵
但关键是——Nd5还在d5！

moves.popup_en: ...Nc6 develops. After the tactical storm, White's knight still stands on d5, demonstrating the lasting value of a secure weak-square outpost.
moves.popup:
Nc6黑方发展
经历战术风暴后
Nd5据点依然屹立不倒！
弱格马的价值在战术中得到验证
